subject.title: fix: harden cloud worker admission and remote turns

question: Has Crabbox v0.38.1 or newer been published through every supported install channel, and should this PR land with stale attached workers intentionally torn down on bundle mismatch?
rationale: The patch is coupled to an unpublished external attestation contract and intentionally changes operator-visible failure and active-placement behavior, so merge timing and upgrade semantics require explicit ownership.

options.title: Publish dependency, then merge
options.body: Publish Crabbox v0.38.1 or newer, verify fresh and upgrade scenarios on the exact PR head, and merge after required checks pass.

options.title: Merge with an outage window
options.body: Merge before dependency publication only if maintainers intentionally accept unavailable AWS admission until operators upgrade.

options.title: Revise stale-worker handling
options.body: Pause landing and define a less disruptive transition if active attached placements must survive bundle changes.

recommendation.title: Publish dependency, then merge
recommendation.body: Publish Crabbox v0.38.1 or newer, verify fresh and upgrade scenarios on the exact PR head, and merge after required checks pass.
